questions.question_english:
93. The Inter-State Council was established in 1990
under Article 263 of the Constitution on the
recommendations of which Commission?
questions.explanation_english: The Inter-State Council was established by presidential order in May 1990 under Article 263 of the Constitution, following recommendations of the Sarkaria Commission on Centre-State Relations (1988). Chaired by the Prime Minister and comprising Chief Ministers of all States and Union Cabinet Ministers, the Council serves as a permanent constitutional forum to investigate, discuss, and advise on inter-state and Union-state policy issues.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अंतर-राज्य परिषद की स्थापना मई 1990 में राष्ट्रपति के आदेश द्वारा संविधान के अनुच्छेद 263 के तहत की गई थी, जो सरकारिया आयोग की सिफारिशों के आधार पर थी। यह परिषद प्रधानमंत्री की अध्यक्षता में कार्य करती है और इसमें सभी राज्यों के मुख्यमंत्री और संघ मंत्रिमंडल के मंत्री शामिल होते हैं। यह परिषद एक स्थायी संवैधानिक मंच के रूप में कार्य करती है जो अंतर-राज्य और संघ-राज्य नीति मुद्दों की जांच, चर्चा और सलाह देने का कार्य करती है।

questions.question_english: Which Schedule was inserted into the Constitution of India by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, listing 29 functional items for Panchayats?
questions.explanation_english: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 inserted Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule into the Constitution of India. The Eleventh Schedule specifically contains 29 functional items—such as agriculture, land improvement, rural housing, drinking water, and poverty alleviation programs—devolved to Panchayats under Article 243G to enable them to function as effective units of local self-government across rural areas throughout the Indian nation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। 73वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 ने भारत के संविधान में भाग IX और ग्यारहवां अनुसूची सम्मिलित किया। ग्यारहवां अनुसूची विशेष रूप से 29 कार्यात्मक विषयों को शामिल करता है—जैसे कृषि, भूमि सुधार, ग्रामीण आवास, पेयजल, और गरीबी उन्मूलन कार्यक्रम—जो पंचायतों को अनुच्छेद 243G के तहत सौंपे गए हैं ताकि वे भारतीय राष्ट्र के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में स्थानीय स्व-सरकार के प्रभावी इकाइयों के रूप में कार्य कर सकें।

questions.question_english:
7.

According to Article 110 of the Constitution, a
Bill is considered a Money Bill if it contains
provisions dealing exclusively with which of the
following?
options_english:
Imposition, abolition, remission, alteration,
or regulation of any tax
Imposition of fines or pecuniary penalties

Payment of fees for licenses or services
rendered

Imposition or alteration of taxes by local
authority for local purposes
questions.explanation_english:
Article 110 specifies that a Bill is deemed to be
a Money Bill if it deals exclusively with matters
such as tax imposition, abolition, remission,
alteration, or regulation, or borrowing money
and custody of the Consolidated Fund. Provisions
relating solely to fines, pecuniary penalties,
licenses, or fees for services rendered, or local
taxes levied by local authorities, are explicitly
excluded from being classified as Money Bills
under this constitutional provision.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुच्छेद 110 यह निर्दिष्ट करता है कि एक
बिल को धन विधेयक माना जाता है यदि यह विशेष रूप से
करों के आरोपण, समाप्ति, छूट, परिवर्तन, या विनियमन,
या धन उधार लेने और समेकित कोष की देखरेख से संबंधित
मामलों से संबंधित है। जुर्माना, वित्तीय दंड, लाइसेंस,
या सेवाओं के लिए शुल्क, या स्थानीय प्राधिकरण द्वारा
लगाए गए स्थानीय करों से संबंधित प्रावधानों को इस
संविधानिक प्रावधान के तहत धन विधेयक के रूप में वर्गीकृत
करने से स्पष्ट रूप से बाहर रखा गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Imposition, abolition, remission, alteration, or regulation of any tax

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 110 specifies that a Bill is deemed to be a Money Bill if it deals exclusively with matters such as tax imposition, abolition, remission, alteration, or regulation.

questions.question_english:
40. Consider the following statements regarding the
National Human Rights Commission (NHRC):
A. While inquiring into complaints, NHRC has
all the powers of a civil court trying a suit
under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
B. NHRC cannot inquire into any matter
after the expiry of one year from the date
on which the act constituting violation of
human rights is committed.
C. The recommendations of NHRC are strictly
binding on government authorities.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english:
The National Human Rights Commission holds
civil court powers under the Code of Civil
Procedure while investigating complaints under
Section 13. Under Section 36(2), NHRC cannot
inquire into human rights violations after one year
from the date of occurrence. However, NHRC
recommendations are advisory in nature and
not legally binding on government authorities,
validating only statements A and B as correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) के पास शिकायतों की जांच करते समय सिविल प्रक्रिया संहिता के तहत सिविल न्यायालय के सभी अधिकार होते हैं। NHRC एक वर्ष की समाप्ति के बाद मानवाधिकारों के उल्लंघन की घटनाओं की जांच नहीं कर सकता है। हालाँकि, NHRC की सिफारिशें सलाहकार होती हैं और सरकारी अधिकारियों पर कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी नहीं होती हैं, जिससे केवल कथन A और B सही होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A and B only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The National Human Rights Commission holds civil court powers under the Code of Civil Procedure while investigating complaints under Section 13.

State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad):
A. Article 169 empowers Parliament to create
or abolish a Legislative Council in a State by
law.
B. The total number of members in a Legislative
Council cannot exceed one-third of the total
membership of the Legislative Assembly of

abolish a State Legislative Council if the State
Assembly passes a resolution by special majority.

of a Council cannot exceed one-third of the
Assembly strength, subject to a minimum of 40
members. Furthermore, one-third of its members
are elected by local bodies like municipalities,

B. Mandamus cannot be issued against a private individual or body that has no public duty.

45. Consider the following statements regarding the State Information Commission (SIC):
A. The State Chief Information Commissioner and State Information Commissioners are appointed by the Governor.
B. The appointment is made on the recommendation of a committee consisting of the Chief Minister, Leader of Opposition in the Legislative Assembly, and a Cabinet Minister nominated by the Chief Minister.
C. The State Information Commission has the powers of a Civil Court while inquiring into any matter under the RTI Act.
D. The State Chief Information Commissioner is eligible for reappointment to the same position.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: State Information Commissioners are appointed by the Governor on the recommendation of a committee comprising the Chief Minister, Leader of Opposition, and a nominated Cabinet Minister. The commission exercises civil court powers under Section 18. However, under Section 15(6) of the RTI Act, 2005, the State Chief Information Commissioner is not eligible for reappointment to the same office, rendering statement D incorrect and validating statements A, B, and C.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। राज्य सूचना आयुक्तों की नियुक्ति राज्यपाल द्वारा मुख्यमंत्री, विपक्ष के नेता और एक नामित कैबिनेट मंत्री की सिफारिश पर की जाती है। आयोग धारा 18 के तहत सिविल कोर्ट के अधिकारों का प्रयोग करता है। हालाँकि, सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2005 की धारा 15(6) के तहत, राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त को उसी पद पर पुनर्नियुक्ति के लिए पात्र नहीं माना जाता है, जिससे कथन D गलत हो जाता है और कथन A, B और C को सही ठहराता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A, B and C only
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The commission exercises civil court powers under Section 18.

questions.question_english:
87. Under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, which of the following office-holders is NOT under the jurisdiction of the Lokpal for inquiry into allegations of corruption?
(1) Prime Minister of India (subject to specified statutory safeguards)
(2) Union Cabinet Ministers and Members of Parliament
(3) Group A, B, C, and D officers of the Central Government
options_english: Judges of the Supreme Court of India and High Courts
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 14 of the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, the Lokpal's jurisdiction does not extend to judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts. This is a significant exclusion, as it ensures the independence of the judiciary from potential political interference or corruption allegations, thereby maintaining the integrity of the judicial system.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। लोकपाल और लोकायुक्त अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 14 के तहत, लोकपाल का अधिकार क्षेत्र सर्वोच्च न्यायालय और उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों तक नहीं फैला है। यह एक महत्वपूर्ण अपवाद है, क्योंकि यह न्यायपालिका की स्वतंत्रता को संभावित राजनीतिक हस्तक्षेप या भ्रष्टाचार के आरोपों से सुरक्षित रखता है, जिससे न्यायिक प्रणाली की अखंडता बनी रहती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Judges of the Supreme Court of India and High Courts
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Judges are excluded from Lokpal's jurisdiction.

questions.question_english: 94. Under which legislation were Statutory Zonal Councils established?
questions.explanation_english: Statutory Zonal Councils were established under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956. This Act created five Zonal Councils (Northern, Central, Eastern, Western, and Southern) to promote inter-state coordination and cooperation on various issues. Unlike the constitutional Inter-State Council, these councils are statutory bodies, with the Union Home Minister serving as the common Chairman and State Chief Ministers acting as rotating Vice-Chairmen.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। वैधानिक क्षेत्रीय परिषदों की स्थापना राज्यों के पुनर्गठन अधिनियम, 1956 के भाग III के तहत की गई थी। इस अधिनियम के तहत पांच क्षेत्रीय परिषदों (उत्तरी, केंद्रीय, पूर्वी, पश्चिमी और दक्षिणी) का निर्माण किया गया था। ये परिषदें विभिन्न मुद्दों पर अंतर-राज्य समन्वय और सहयोग को बढ़ावा देने के लिए बनाई गई हैं। संविधान के अंतर-राज्य परिषद के विपरीत, ये परिषदें वैधानिक निकाय हैं, जिनमें केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री सामान्य अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य करते हैं और राज्य के मुख्यमंत्री घूर्णन उपाध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) States Reorganisation Act, 1956
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Five Zonal Councils were created under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956.

27. Which Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Article 239AA of the Constitution of India,
which provides special provisions with respect to Delhi?
questions.explanation_english:
Article 239AA was inserted into the Constitution
of India by the 69th Constitutional Amendment
Act, 1991. This amendment conferred special
status upon the Union Territory of Delhi,
redesignating it as the National Capital Territory
of Delhi, and created a Legislative Assembly
alongside a Council of Ministers headed by a
Chief Minister to govern the national capital
under specific constitutional parameters.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अनुच्छेद 239AA को संविधान में 69वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1991 द्वारा जोड़ा गया था। इस संशोधन ने दिल्ली को विशेष स्थिति प्रदान की और इसे राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र के रूप में पुनः नामित किया।
